summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The m+ Income Momentum Autocall ETF (MPIM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed to pursue high monthly income with reduced downside risk by using swaps to track a laddered portfolio of up to 52 synthetic autocallable notes referencing a momentum-based, volatility-managed U.S. equity futures index. MPIM was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by m+ Funds.
